description:
We are seeking a dedicated SDC/Infection Control Nurse to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Oakland, MD. This vital role offers a competitive hourly rate of $40-$42, providing an excellent opportunity for a skilled professional to make a significant impact on staff development and patient safety.

In this dual-focused position, you will be instrumental in coordinating staff education and training programs, ensuring our team is equipped with the latest knowledge and skills. Concurrently, you will lead our infection prevention and control initiatives, safeguarding the health and well-being of residents and staff through robust protocols and surveillance.

If you are a proactive and compassionate nurse with a passion for education and infection control, we encourage you to apply. Join a facility committed to excellence in care and a supportive work environment.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in Maryland
Experience in staff development and education within a healthcare setting
Demonstrated experience in infection prevention and control practices
Strong understanding of state and federal regulations for skilled nursing facilities
Excellent communication, organizational, and leadership skills
salaryOrBonusInfo: Hourly rate of $40-$42 based on experience.

description:
We are seeking an experienced and dynamic Marketing Director to join a premier skilled nursing facility in Sarasota County, FL. This is a unique opportunity to contribute to a recently purchased facility, bringing your expertise to a team dedicated to growth and excellence. The ideal candidate will be a proactive and results-driven individual with a strong ability to build relationships and drive census.

As the Marketing Director, you will be responsible for developing and executing comprehensive marketing strategies to enhance the facility's presence and attract new residents. This role requires a professional and presentable individual who thrives in a fast-paced environment and is committed to achieving ambitious goals. Flexibility to work occasional weekends will be essential to meet the demands of community engagement and outreach.

If you are a 'hustler' with a passion for healthcare marketing and a proven track record of success, we encourage you to apply. This position offers competitive compensation for the right candidate, reflecting the value placed on your experience and contributions to our growing team.
requirements: Proven experience as a Marketing Director, preferably in a skilled nursing or long-term care setting
Demonstrated ability to drive census and build community relationships
Professional demeanor and excellent communication skills
Flexibility to work occasional weekends as needed
Strong initiative and a results-oriented approach
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation is competitive and based on experience for the right candidate.

description:
We are urgently seeking a dedicated PRN Speech Language Pathologist (SLP) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Inverness, FL. This critical role offers the flexibility of PRN shifts, allowing you to make a significant impact on patient recovery and well-being while balancing your professional and personal life. You will be an essential part of a compassionate team, providing vital speech and language therapy services to residents.

This opportunity comes with a highly competitive hourly rate ranging from $38.00 to $49.00, reflecting the critical nature of the position. Additionally, a generous $5,000 sign-on or relocation bonus is available to welcome you to our team. If you are a skilled SLP looking for a rewarding PRN role with excellent compensation, we encourage you to apply.
requirements: Current state licensure as a Speech-Language Pathologist in Florida
Certificate of Clinical Competence in Speech-Language Pathology (CCC-SLP)
Experience in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation setting preferred
Ability to work PRN shifts as needed
salaryOrBonusInfo: Hourly rate of $38.00 - $49.00, with a $5,000 sign-on or relocation bonus available.
